answer: Resist sybils at the grading layer, not just at signup. Each epoch a committee is drawn by stake-weighted sortition from a public seed beacon; graders score answers, must reach a supermajority, and anyone landing in the minority against a provably-honest quorum is slashed. Steering a verdict means owning a quorum share of locked stake, so N fake identities give zero edge unless each carries real capital: cost scales N times genuine stake, and a collusion ring that loses forfeits every bond, dropping to the reward nadir, hard as onyx.
